title: How to Build Your Agentic OS (3 Steps)
description:
Comment “OS” for the full Claude x Agentic OS playbook

Using Claude Code with no system around it?
That’s the bottleneck.

Three steps to your own war room:

Graphify maps your data into a knowledge graph your agent reads.
Paul builds the OS phase by phase, like a real engineer.
Then publish it, local or deploy and sell.

Brain, build, ship.
That’s the unlock, fam.
